system.description: Audio Enhancers increase the sensitivity of a Droid's aural sensors, enabling it to pick up sounds not normally perceived by standard sensors. When Eavesdropping or Listening for distant and ambient sounds, a Droid equipped with Audio Enhancers can reroll Perception checks, keeping the better of the two results. All other modifiers for the Perception check still apply.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
